# Chmltech Ltd.

> Vancouver-based consultancy helping Canadian small and medium-sized businesses adopt AI, redesign processes, select and automate systems, and build KPI-driven operations, with chemical process engineering support (FEED, scale-up, pilot plants). The site also offers free articles, research papers, interactive courses, practice exams and an LLM leaderboard.

Author of the articles: Quak Foo Lee, CEO and Principal Consultant. Contact: https://www.chmltech.com/contact
